description: This Java source file defines the CalculatorUI class, which provides a graphical user interface for a calculator application using SWT. It manages UI components such as display, number buttons, and operation buttons, and interacts with the Calculator backend.

classes.name: CalculatorUI
classes.description: A class implementing a SWT-based calculator user interface, handling display, number and operation buttons, and user interactions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the SWT display and opens the calculator UI window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the calculator UI shell.

methods.name: CalculatorUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the calculator backend.

methods.name: setupGUI
methods.description: Sets up the main GUI layout, including display and buttons.

methods.name: setupDisplay
methods.description: Creates and initializes the display text widget.

methods.name: setupNumberButtons
methods.description: Creates number buttons (0-9 and decimal point).

methods.name: addNumberButton
methods.description: Adds a number button to the UI.

methods.name: addCommandButton
methods.description: Adds an operation button to the UI.

methods.name: widgetDefaultSelected
methods.description: Empty implementation for default selection event.

methods.name: widgetSelected
methods.description: Handles button click events and delegates to calculator logic.

methods.name: setDisplayText
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with provided text.

methods.name: getDisplayText
methods.description: Retrieves current text from the display.
